name: Fateweaver: Smash or Pass
source:
You play The Fateweaver; an ancient beast of legendary status. It is your job to determine which way Fate will unravel as you test the fragile laws of morality, dig deep into the psyche of those who call for your aid, and decide whether or not to help those who beg for your mercy, or invoke the wrath of the Gods upon those you deem unworthy of existence...

As you interrogate those who have summoned you and get to know the details of their lives on an intimate level, you will take their answers into consideration before deciding which way the story will unfold. Will you grant them solace and reprieve? Or will you incite carnage and retribution? There is no right or wrong way to weave the threads of Fate... For their poor, desperate souls rest in the palm of your hand...

In this episode of The Fateweaver Series, you must meet with an oafish Ogre, Thadeus Mancannon, who has beckoned you in his time of need. Overwhelmed by sadness, the lonely Ogre has been filled with rage in his quest to SMASH anyone and anything that dares cross his path...
Will you bring Thadeus' dreams to fruition and calm the wild beast, or will you drive him further into madness where he may succumb to his inner desires for carnage?

As always, the choice is yours to make...
translation:
你将扮演命运编织者，一头声名如传说般的远古巨兽。你的职责，是决定命运如何展开：试探脆弱的道德法则，深入求助者的内心，决定是否帮助那些乞求怜悯的人，或将诸神之怒降于你认为不配存在的人……

你将盘问召唤自己的人，深入了解他们生活中的细节，斟酌他们的回答，再决定故事走向。你会赐予安慰与喘息，还是引发杀戮与报复？编织命运之线，并无对错之分……因为这些可怜而绝望的灵魂，都握在你掌心……

在命运编织者系列的这一篇中，你必须会见笨拙的食人魔Thadeus Mancannon，他在困境中召唤了你。孤独的食人魔被悲伤淹没，愤怒充斥内心，一心想要砸烂一切胆敢挡路的人和物……
你会实现Thadeus的梦想，安抚这头狂暴野兽，还是把他推向更深的疯狂，任其屈从内心嗜血的欲望？

一如既往，选择权在你……
